# Intersog Israel

> Intersog Israel is a global software development outsourcing and IT staffing company specializing in AI, blockchain, cloud, IoT, and enterprise solutions.

Intersog Israel offers comprehensive software development services ranging from custom enterprise applications to cutting-edge AI and blockchain solutions. With expertise spanning cloud infrastructure, data science, cybersecurity, and mobile/web development, the company serves startups and enterprises through dedicated teams and strategic consulting.

- Software Development Outsourcing
- IT Staffing

- Blockchain Development
- Cloud & DevOps

- Cybersecurity

- Natural Language Processing
